theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) {t p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (ht : t ≠ 0) : |x| ^ p ≤ (p / |t|) ^ p * max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) := by
  have h1 : |t| > 0 := mt (ne_zero_iff_gt.2 ht)
  have h2 : (p / |t|) ≥ 0 := div_nonneg hp h1
  have h3 : max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) ≥ Real.exp (t * x) := max_le_left _ _
  have h4 : max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) ≥ Real.exp (-t * x) := max_le_right _ _
  have h5 : Real.exp (t * x) ≥ 0 := Real.exp_nonneg _
  have h6 : Real.exp (-t * x) ≥ 0 := Real.exp_nonneg _
  have h7 : max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) ≥ 0 := max_le _ _ h5 h6
  have h8 : (p / |t|) ^ p * max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) ≥ 0 :=
    mul_nonneg h2 h7
  have h9 : |x| ^ p ≥ 0 := pow_nonneg hp
  have h10 : (p / |t|) ^ p * max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) ≥ |x| ^ p :=
    le_trans (Real.exp_le_cosh_add_mul_sinh ht (Real.abs x)) (Real.cosh_add_mul_sinh_le_exp_max t x)
  exact le_trans h9 h10
